geometry_edits.rationale: Convert the current wrapped courtyard into a split-wing composition to create a clearer public void and stronger neighborhood threshold while preserving the existing dominant body in ancestry.
Split along the long axis so the void aligns with the street-building section logic.
Increase the gap to make the void legible as usable shared space rather than a decorative incision.
Maintain a continuous ground connection to satisfy the active-edge requirement.
Keep enough mass at grade to preserve a dominant anchor while opening the frontage.
Reduce the spine height so the public threshold reads clearly from the ground.

graph_edits.rationale: Replace the single enclosed courtyard primary with a split-wing massing rule so the neighborhood-living figure can create a more legible public threshold and active ground relation.
Orient the split along the long axis to form a clearer open-space figure tied to the frontage.
Open the center enough to read as an occupiable court rather than a small punched void.
Preserve a continuous ground anchor so the mass remains one building rather than separated fragments.
Keep the anchor substantial enough for neighborhood-living hierarchy.
Lower the spine so the threshold reads as public and not overbuilt.

rationale: The candidate reads consistently across the four views as one compact, slightly tapered block with a carved top void and a small street-side notch, so it has a coherent dominant gesture and decent repair integrity. However, the form still behaves more like a generic tower/block than a neighborhood-living street building: the public threshold is underdeveloped, the road frontage is not strongly or correctly activated, and the internal court is too small/abstract to count as a meaningful public void. The silhouette is coherent but only modestly resolved as a capacity-bearing section; it does not yet express a convincing inhabited terrace or a robust mixed-use ground-to-upper hierarchy. In program terms, it can plausibly host neighborhood-living only at a weak level, but the visible mass does not yet strongly support the required active edge + public space + calm upper hierarchy contract, so program_fit_hard_pass fails.
